questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Derive the equation of the parabola with focus (0, -1) and directrix y = 1 from the distance definition.
questions.prompt_markup: Derive the equation of the parabola with focus (0, -1) and directrix y = 1 from the distance definition.
questions.required_method: √(x² + (y + 1)²) = |y - 1| written, both sides squared, and simplified: x² + 2y = -2y, so x² = -4y.
questions.grading_note: Form required: the derivation and the equation (any equivalent form, such as y = -{1/4}x²).
